Extract births with known parents to unpartnered mothers

Source: R/get_unpartnered_births.R
get_unpartnered_births.Rd

Return births where the mother was outside both cohabitation and marriage, with parent ages and optional groups supplied by get_parent_info(). Known mother and father IDs are required. Each birth is retained separately, including repeated parental pairs; missing-parent records and founders are omitted. These rows can be used to examine nonpartnership father matching.

Usage

get_unpartnered_births(population)

Arguments

population

A validated hammel_population with person and union histories, such as the result of simulate().

Value

A separate tibble containing selected person rows and age_mother, age_father, plus group_mother and group_father when groups are present. Input order, column types and custom person columns are preserved. Empty results retain the enriched schema. The population is not modified.

Details

Histories must be complete for the intended interpretation. Partnership coverage is half-open: births at formation are partnered. Births exactly at dissolution or conversion retain the ending partnership (birth-first ties). Births at death endings are unpartnered unless another episode covers that time. Overlapping episodes do not duplicate births. Untyped partnerships are treated as partnered too. No time window is imposed and no endpoint is needed.

Examples

population <- create_baseline_population(10)
get_unpartnered_births(population)
#> # A tibble: 0 × 8
#> # ℹ 8 variables: person_id <int>, sex <chr>, birth_time <dbl>,
#> #   death_time <dbl>, mother_id <int>, father_id <int>, age_mother <dbl>,
#> #   age_father <dbl>
